acceptance: Every TPC-DS case in the corpus matches: parameter values and stream order exactly, then normalised text.
Scale-model gate: rowcount() values equal library row/key counts at 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 10, 100, 1000 and 3000.
Q9 at SF 3000 within 2x of dsqgen time and memory.
description:
docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md decision 8 (query generation in Rust). Interpreter for the dsqgen template language over BenchBox-supplied templates and tpcds.idx, rowcount() from the library's scale model (including BenchBox's patched fractional curve), all three draw shapes, stream permutation, -LOG style parameter output. Land crr-o2-official-tpcds-stream-zero first if it simplifies official mode.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
